mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor_schedule ds LEFT JOIN ( SELECT schedule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM appointment WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY schedule_id ) x ON x.schedule_id = ds.id WHERE ds.booked_count <> COALESCE(x.cnt, 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_slot s LEFT JOIN appointment a ON a.slot_id = s.id AND a.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) WHERE s.status = 1 AND a.id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_record p JOIN appointment a ON a.id = p.appointment_id WHERE p.status = 2 AND a.status IN (6, 7, 8, 9)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_slot s LEFT JOIN doctor_schedule ds ON ds.id = s.schedule_id WHERE ds.id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_schedule ds LEFT JOIN ( SELECT schedule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM appointment WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY schedule_id ) x ON x.schedule_id = ds.id SET ds.booked_count = COALESCE(x.cnt, 0) WHERE ds.booked_count <> COALESCE(x.cnt, 0)
UPDATE schedule_slot s LEFT JOIN appointment a ON a.slot_id = s.id AND a.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) SET s.status = 0 WHERE s.status = 1 AND a.id IS NULL

UPDATE payment_record p JOIN appointment a ON a.id = p.appointment_id SET p.status = 5, p.refunded_at = COALESCE(p.refunded_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), p.refund_reason = COALESCE(p.refund_reason, '管理员一致性修复') WHERE p.status = 2 AND a.status IN (6, 7, 8, 9)
